title: What Does Balboa Park's Future Look Like?
description:
Calling all Balboa Park lovers! 💗  We want your input to help shape the park’s future.

We’re launching the first comprehensive update to the Balboa Park Master Plan since 1989, and community feedback is a key part of the process. Take the initial survey and let us know your thoughts on how the park should grow, connect to neighborhoods and best serve everyone who enjoys it.

The Master Plan update will help the City prioritize critical infrastructure improvements, preserve the park’s historic and cultural assets and explore sustainable funding strategies to support its long-term needs. This survey is just the beginning of the community engagement process – there will be many more opportunities to share your ideas and help shape the future of Balboa Park. 

Learn more about the update and take the survey: insidesandiego.org/first-comprehensive-update-balboa-park-master-plan-1989-now-works

#BalboaPark #CityOfSanDiego #SanDiegoParks
